summary: Bank7 Corp. filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Century, which will merge into Bank7 as the surviving entity, followed by Century Bank's merger into Bank7's bank subsidiary. Century shareholders receive aggregate consideration of $70,000,000 cash plus 1,232,657 Bank7 shares, equal to $210.41 cash and 3.7052 shares per Century share. Both boards unanimously approved. Bank7 retains rights under a prior Receiver Purchase Agreement for a controlling interest as a fallback if the merger terminates.
